name: stage_handtuned_proto_steps_v1_gaitcycle
description: A/B variant of picrawler_handtuned_proto_steps_v1.json — identical reward shape + walk channels, with the new GAIT-CYCLE PULSE reward enabled (gait_cycle_reward_gain=1.0). One discrete events.hit pulse fires per 4-foot touchdown cycle that also satisfies (a) net signed progress >= 5 mm in the active walk_reward_mode direction (radial outward here), and (b) max backward excursion <= 2 mm (anti-wobble / anti-reward-hacking guard). Direction-mode-aware: uses the same walk_v projection that the per-tick walk and gated channels already use, so the gait reward and the navigation reward agree on what 'forward' means. Cycle window 2 s (120 ticks @60Hz). Default no specific sequence — trot/pace/bound/wave all qualify as long as the displacement + wobble bars are met. Hypothesis: the per-tick walk channels reward forward velocity but don't reward closing an actual locomotion cycle, so the brain has no direct gradient toward limit-cycle structure (cycle = the thing that distinguishes gait from drift). Pulse magnitude 1.0 chosen to be comparable to standing density (~0.04 hits/tick) at one good cycle per second (1.0 * 1/60 = 0.017 hits/tick).
